title: The Dominican Republic: mountains, whales and bays
goal: Describe the Dominican Republic's mountains, bays and wildlife with relative clauses (*que* and *quien*).
grammar: relative clauses with que and quien, applied to the Dominican landscape

items: I can describe a mountain, a bay or a lake with a relative clause (*que*, *quien*).
I can say what makes Pico Duarte, Samaná Bay, Los Haitises and Lake Enriquillo different from each other.
I can use the new words for mountains, mangroves and frost.
